description: One table of cases for every reader (schema 9.11.0): the carousel — the «carousel» field on a Row with «scrollable» and on a Repeater laid out in a row. Rules: x-style.layout.carousel; policy rows carouselOutsideHost, unreadableCarousel, carouselCardWidth, carouselNested, carouselState, carouselGestures, carouselIndicator, carouselReducedMotion. Numbers are logical pixels under the theme below (the values of the built-in theme). Nothing is rounded: 85.33333333333333 is the expected width, compare with a tolerance of 1e-9. Offsets are distances from the LOGICAL start: in a right-to-left language the same numbers are measured from the right edge. «readerOnly» — a value the builder does not produce or does not publish; a reader may still receive it. «dotCases.viewport» is the width of the carousel area (the viewport of the stops): the row of dots is «stops × dotSize + (stops − 1) × dotGap» wide and is not drawn, with no room, when it is wider than the area. The «stop…» groups (schema 9.32.0) are the field «carousel.stopPath»: rules x-carouselStop; «stopRunCases» run on «stopRunScreen» with the widths of «stopRunLayout», «offset» is the scroll offset after the steps and «behavior» the last programmatic scroll. The «autoAdvance…» groups (schema 9.42.0) are the field «carousel.autoAdvance»: rules x-carouselAutoAdvance; «autoAdvanceTickCases» is one tick of the timer, «autoAdvanceRunCases» run on «autoAdvanceRunScreen» with the widths of «stopRunLayout», a tick every 100 ms, «wait» is the time that passes in milliseconds, «field: noPath» drops «stopPath», «field: off» drops «autoAdvance», «loop» adds «loop: true», «inert» draws the screen under a modal layer. Written by hand, not generated.

hostCases.name: a data list laid out in a row
a data list laid out in a column
a data list without the «direction» field: a column
a data list with «columns»: the direction is not read at all
a container laid out in a row is not a host

readCases.name: an empty object: a carousel with natural widths and dots
one card in view, the peek by a token
two cards, the peek by a number, no dots
a fractional «perView» is not «two and a half cards»: natural widths
a negative peek: the default; the rest of the field is kept
a peek that is not a spacing reference: the default
an unknown indicator word (a newer minor): the default, dots
a key of a newer minor is skipped
«true» is not a carousel: the row scrolls as before
a string is not a carousel
a number is not a carousel
an array is not a carousel

cardCases.name: 320: one card, padding lg, gap md, peek xl
768: the same carousel — the peek stays 24, the card grows
320: three cards, gap sm — a width that is not a whole pixel, not rounded
no «peek» field: the default token lg
a peek token the theme does not declare: the default token lg
peek none: the gap after the last whole card still shows
no padding, no gap, no peek: the card is the viewport
393: the zero token everywhere — one card fills the whole viewport, not its natural width
the end padding does not enter the width
narrower than the smallest card: «perView» is not read, natural widths

stopCases.name: 320, three cards of 268: the last card stops at the end of the scroll, not at its own start
393, six cards, three in view: four stops for six cards — the last three share the end
no cards (an empty data list): one stop
natural widths, no padding: every card start is a stop until the end of the scroll
a card start within half a pixel of the end is the end
a single card wider than the viewport: its start and the end of the scroll
the last card wider than the viewport: the end of the scroll is one more stop
the end padding lengthens the scroll

activeCases.name: exactly between two stops: the earlier one
between the second and the last, a tie: the earlier one

dotCases.name: one stop: no dots and no room for them
ten stops: the most dots drawn
eleven stops: no dots and no room for them
ten stops in an area of exactly 152 (10 × 8 + 9 × 8): the row fits, the dots are drawn
ten stops in an area of 151: the row of 152 does not fit, no dots and no room for them
three stops in an area of 30: the row of 40 does not fit, no dots and no room for them
two stops in an area of exactly 24 (2 × 8 + 8): the row fits, the dots are drawn

areaCases.name: 337: a carousel in a row container next to a sibling — the place gives it 252 (a 360 container, a sibling of 100, a gap of 8); with dots
337: the same place, the same carousel WITHOUT dots: the area and the stops do not change because the dots are not drawn
337: a place of 36: the dots row (4 stops → 56) is wider than the area, so it is not drawn — the area stays 36 and the stops are the same as without dots
337: the same place of 36 with dots off: the same stops

stateCases.name: 340: the same node, no list: one state
340: the same node in two rows of a list from data: two states, each row keeps its own stop
340: the same row of the list: one state
340: two different nodes of the same row: two states
340: a list inside a list: the whole chain of instances counts, not the last index
340: the chain [1] is not the chain [0, 1]

stopPathCases.name: a scrolling row with a carousel and a path: the path is read
a data list in a row with a carousel and a path: the path is read
no field: no path, the carousel writes nothing
a row that does not scroll is not a carousel: the path is not read
a path that is not a string: no path
a path longer than 128 characters: no path
an unreadable carousel (not an object): no carousel, no path

stopShownCases.name: 1.0 is the integer 1 (a double in Dart)
7 with three stops: clamped to the last
a fraction names no stop: the first
the text "1" is not a number: the first stop
a flag is not a number: the first stop
content that fits has one stop: every value shows it
stops, not cards: six cards three in view are four stops, 5 shows the last

stopFollowCases.name: the value changed 0 → 2: move to stop 2
1 → no value: back to the first stop
the person wrote 2 and the value became 2: the carousel is there already, no move
the value did not change (a refused write): the carousel stays where the person left it
1 and 1.0 are one number: no change
"x" → no value: both name no stop, no change
1 → 9 with three stops: the change moves to the last stop
7 → 9 with three stops while at the last stop: no move

stopWriteCases.name: a person settled on stop 1, no value: write 1
a person settled on the first stop, no value: write 0 — the person chose it
a person settled on the stop already held: not written again
held as 2.0: the same number, not written again
held as the text "2": not the same value, write the number 2
the reader moved it (show, following the value): never written
the value is out of range and the person settled on the last stop: write the stop

stopDocumentCases.name: a scrolling row with a number path: published
a data list in a row with a number path: published
a path the data contract does not know: unknown_binding_path
a text path: binding_type_mismatch — the stop is a number
a carousel with a path in the template of a list from data: input_inside_repeater — every row would write the same path
a path on a row that does not scroll: the carousel outside its host (invalid_document), the whole carousel is not read
an empty path: rejected by the schema
a path of 129 characters: rejected by the schema
a path that is not a string: rejected by the schema

stopRunCases.name: show with no value: the first stop, nothing written, nothing moved
show with the value 2: starts at stop 2 without animation, nothing written
show with 7 and three stops: clamped to the last stop
a swipe settles on stop 1: writes 1, the content of card 2 shows
a swipe away and back to the first stop with no value: writes 0
a swipe back to the stop already held: not written again
the scroll pauses while the finger still holds the row: nothing written
released where the scroll already stands (no momentum, no scrollend): written after the quiet time
a scroll by the wheel settles by quiet time: written
an own dot writes 2: the carousel moves to stop 2 and does not write again
an own dot with reduced motion: the move is not animated
a dot, then a swipe: the dot writes 2, the swipe writes 1
the dot of the shown card: the value is held, nothing written, nothing moved
a carousel without the field: a swipe writes nothing

stopRuleCases.name: the block refines the active stop of x-style.layout.carousel
the path is a number path
the path is a literal of the document
the value counts stops, not cards
written only after a person moved it and the scroll settled
the same number is not written again
a change of the number moves the carousel, not a comparison at draw time
inside a list from data: not published

autoAdvanceReadCases.name: a scrolling row with auto-advance: the interval is read, no loop
a data list in a row with auto-advance: read
loop true: back to the first stop after the last
no field: no auto-advance, only a person moves the carousel
the interval under the lower bound: clamped to 2000
the interval over the upper bound: clamped to 15000
a fraction in the bounds: read as it is
the interval is a string: not a number, the lower bound
no interval in the object: not a number, the lower bound
loop is not the literal true: as absent
the field is not an object: no auto-advance
a row that does not scroll: the carousel is not read, neither is the field

autoAdvanceNextCases.name: the first of three stops: the second
the second of three: the third
the last with loop: the first
one stop, even with loop: nowhere
an active stop past the last one: clamped to the last, nowhere
a negative active stop: clamped to the first, the second

autoAdvanceTickCases.name: not paused: the count grows by the time since the last tick
the count reaches the interval: a step to the next stop, the count from 0 there
a long gap between ticks: one step, not several
paused while the stop already changed (the scroll still moves): nothing changes
the stop changed otherwise (a person, the value): the count from 0, no step
the last stop without loop: the count stands at the interval, no step
the timer stopped on the last stop: stays stopped
the last stop with loop: a step to the first
a negative time since the last tick counts as 0
the timer stopped on the last stop, a person went back: the count from 0

autoAdvanceWriteCases.name: a step to stop 1, no value: write 1
a step to stop 1, the value is already 1: not written again
a step to stop 1, the value is the string "1": written, equality is typed
a step to the first stop after loop, the value 2: write 0

autoAdvanceDocumentCases.name: a scrolling row of three cards with auto-advance: published
with loop and the stop path: published
a data list in a row with auto-advance: published, the number of records is not known
a row with one card: nothing to move to, carousel_auto_advance_not_read
a row with no cards: carousel_auto_advance_not_read
the interval under 2000: not by the schema
the interval over 15000: not by the schema
a fraction of a millisecond: not by the schema
no interval: not by the schema
loop false: not by the schema, stopping is the absence of the field
an unknown key in the object: not by the schema
a row that does not scroll: the carousel outside its host (invalid_document), the whole carousel is not read

autoAdvanceRunCases.name: before the interval: nothing moved, nothing written
after the interval: a step to stop 1, written, the caption of story 2 shows
the last stop without loop: the timer stops there
with loop: after the last stop back to the first
reduced motion: the step is instant, the timer still runs
held: the count is frozen while the finger is down
released: the count resumes with what was left, not a new interval
released, the rest of the interval passed: the step
a swipe restarts the count from the new stop
a swipe, then a whole interval: the step from the new stop
shown at the last stop by the value: no step, nothing written
the app in the background: the count is frozen
back from the background: the count resumes
under a modal layer (inert): no step
without the stop path: the carousel moves, nothing is written

autoAdvanceRuleCases.name: the block refines the active stop and the write of the stop path
the lower bound of the interval
the upper bound of the interval
the last stop without loop: the timer stops
the step writes the stop path
the older reader skips the field
